[PREFERENCE] The user has already tried adjusting screen brightness and closing unused apps.  
[PREFERENCE] The user is considering looking into power-saving mode and turning off location services for certain apps.  
[FACT] The user inquired about the impact of their wireless charging pad on battery life.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant stated that wireless charging is unlikely to be the primary cause of battery life issues but mentioned potential impacts:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Heat generation can degrade the battery faster.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Wireless charging is less efficient than wired charging.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Standby power consumption from some wireless charging pads.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided recommendations for minimizing the impact of wireless charging, including using a high-quality pad and keeping it away from heat sources.  
[EVENT] The user is thinking of getting a portable power bank for travel.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Capacity (at least 10,000mAh recommended).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Output matching phone charging speed.
